attention_all_ready: Everything is ready on the server. Nothing to do.
attention_conflict_text: was changed on two devices at the same time.
attention_nothing: Nothing to do. Every device is online and in sync.
attention_waiting_one: 1 change is ready on the server and is sent as soon as the device is back. Nothing to do.
attention_waiting_other: {count} changes are ready on the server and are sent as soon as the device is back. Nothing to do.
conflict_both_after: . The discarded version stays among the versions.
conflict_both_before: Not sure? “Keep both” puts the other version next to it as
conflict_explained: Changed on two devices before the first change arrived. Both versions are safe on the server.
conflict_no_preview: No text preview (binary file or larger than 256 KB).
conflicts_description: When two devices change the same file before they know of each other, the server keeps both versions. Here you decide which one stays.
devices_description: Each device only runs a small agent. Everything else you set here.
devices_remove_confirm: Remove {device}? The device loses all folders; its files stay.
folder_meta_one: on 1 device and the server · Syncthing ID
folder_meta_other: on {count} devices and the server · Syncthing ID
folder_new_path_hint: A new path sets the folder up again on the device; files already at the new place are matched.
folder_no_conflicts: No conflicts. When two devices change the same file before they know of each other, it shows up here.
folders_description: Every folder is on the server in full and on the devices that get it.
login_no_password_before: No password set yet. On the server, run
matrix_applied_all: Applied. Every device has the new configuration.
matrix_applied_waiting_one: Applied. {now} sent right away, 1 waits for offline devices.
matrix_applied_waiting_other: Applied. {now} sent right away, {waiting} wait for offline devices.
matrix_applies_now: Applied right away on every device concerned.
matrix_footer: The server keeps a full copy of every folder, with versions. Devices that are never online at the same time sync through it.
matrix_hint: Click a cell to change its mode. Offline devices get the change as soon as they are back.
matrix_no_folders: No folders yet. Create the first one with “New folder”.
matrix_offline_one: 1 of them is for an offline device and follows when it is back.
matrix_offline_other: {count} of them are for offline devices and follow when they are back.
name: Name
new_folder_description: The server keeps a copy of every folder. Which devices get it, you set in the overview afterwards.
overview_description: Who syncs what with whom – set in one place, applied on every device automatically.
pair_code_valid: The code in the command is valid for 15 minutes and works once.
pair_default_mode: Default mode: both. You can change paths and mode per folder afterwards.
pair_description: Run once on the new device. From then on it is managed only here.
pair_lan_hint: In the same network it also works without a code: run “stellwerk-agent join” on the device, then approve it under Devices.
pair_wait_hint: It shows up here by itself as soon as the command has run.
settings_ignore_label: One pattern per line, applies on every device and the server.
settings_remove_hint: Stops syncing everywhere. Files on the devices and the server stay.
share_offline_waiting_one: Offline · 1 change waits on the server
share_offline_waiting_other: Offline · {count} changes wait on the server
share_waiting_online: Waits until the device is online
stat_all_current: Every device is up to date
stat_waiting_one: 1 device waits for the new configuration
stat_waiting_other: {count} devices wait for the new configuration
versions_explained: When a device changes or deletes a file, the server keeps the previous version. Restoring keeps the current version there first, too.
versions_restored: {path} restored. The devices get the file with the next sync.
waiting_description: These devices in the LAN want to pair without a code. Only approve one if its fingerprint matches the one shown on the device.
